data.name: Subash
data.gender_notes: Subash is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Subash comes from the Sanskrit word 'subha' meaning good, auspicious or radiant. In Hindu mythology, the name is also associated with Subashchandra, a heroic figure known for his wisdom and bravery. The name Subash carries the meaning “Good, Auspicious, Radiant” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Subash usually hope their child will grow to embody good, auspicious, radiant and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Subash belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Good, Auspicious, Radiant.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Subash total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
